evals.prompt: 帮我 review 一下这份 draft 的 consistency。我准备投 CVPR 2026，麻烦按 paper-write-skill 的 4-component 检查 abstract、intro、method 三者之间是否对得上。Draft 在 evals/inputs/consistency-review-draft.md。
evals.expected_output: A diagnostic report identifying cross-section inconsistencies in structure, grammar, sentence connections, and especially consistency between abstract / intro / method. Should include concrete rewrite suggestions.
